answer: Autonomous agent economies can resist Sybil attacks through cooperative LiDAR pose-graph registration. Each agent acts as a vertex in a spatial graph, authenticating peers by matching 3D point clouds against mutual motion trajectories. An attacker must purchase physical scanning hardware and deploy a separate robotic chassis per identity. However, geometric degeneracy in a bare canyon and foliage motion in a public garden degrade point alignment, causing false rejections.
